/hr/ghcr.io-home-operations-charts-mirro.title: external-dns helm release
/hr/ghcr.io-home-operations-charts-mirro.name: external-dns
/hr/ghcr.io-home-operations-charts-mirro.doc: ExternalDNS is a Kubernetes add-on that automatically manages the creation and updates of DNS records for services running in your cluster. It integrates with a variety of DNS providers, such as CloudFlare DNS, Amazon Route 53, Google Cloud DNS, and more, to ensure that your applications are easily accessible from anywhere with a DNS name. With ExternalDNS, you can simplify the process of managing DNS records for your home lab, eliminating the need for manual updates and reducing the risk of errors.

0:
upstreams:
  init:
    # answer queries immediately instead of blocking on upstream checks
    strategy: fast
  groups:
    default:
      - tcp-tls:one.one.one.one:853
      - tcp-tls:dns.quad9.net:853
  strategy: parallel_best
  timeout: 2s

# resolves the DoT hostnames above, avoiding a chicken-and-egg at startup
bootstrapDns:
  - tcp+udp:1.1.1.1
  - tcp+udp:9.9.9.9

# static records for hosts outside the cluster. Resolved above the
# conditional forward below, so these win; every other name under
# the domain still falls through to k8s-gateway.
customDNS:
  mapping:
    analytics.${SECRET_DOMAIN}: 192.168.100.11
    auth.${SECRET_DOMAIN}: 192.168.100.11
    budget.${SECRET_DOMAIN}: 192.168.100.11
    budget-tap.${SECRET_DOMAIN}: 192.168.100.11
    budget-tap-pz.${SECRET_DOMAIN}: 192.168.100.11
    dash.${SECRET_DOMAIN}: 192.168.100.11
    feed.${SECRET_DOMAIN}: 192.168.100.11
    forge.${SECRET_DOMAIN}: 192.168.100.11
    idp-home.${SECRET_DOMAIN}: 192.168.100.11
    pf.${SECRET_DOMAIN}: 192.168.100.11
    portfolio-staging.${SECRET_DOMAIN}: 192.168.100.11
    prx-home.${SECRET_DOMAIN}: 192.168.100.11
    pz8-home.${SECRET_DOMAIN}: 192.168.100.11
    sure.${SECRET_DOMAIN}: 192.168.100.11
    whoami-home.${SECRET_DOMAIN}: 192.168.100.11
    pve1.lan.${SECRET_DOMAIN}: 192.168.1.3

conditional:
  # a miss stays a miss, never leaks the internal name to Cloudflare
  fallbackUpstream: false
  mapping:
    ${SECRET_DOMAIN}: 192.168.100.103

blocking:
  denylists:
    main:
      - https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/hagezi/dns-blocklists@latest/wildcard/pro.txt
      - https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/hagezi/dns-blocklists@latest/wildcard/tif.txt
      - https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/hagezi/dns-blocklists@latest/wildcard/fake.txt
  allowlists:
    main: []
  clientGroupsBlock:
    default:
      - main
  blockType: zeroIp
  loading:
    refreshPeriod: 4h
    # serve while lists are still downloading
    strategy: fast
    downloads:
      # the wildcard lists are large, 60s is not enough
      timeout: 4m
      attempts: 3
      cooldown: 10s

caching:
  minTime: 5m
  maxTime: 30m
  prefetching: true

prometheus:
  enable: true
  path: /metrics

ports:
  dns:
    - 5353
  http:
    - 4000

queryLog:
  type: console

log:
  level: info
  format: json
